parameters.query:
WITH u AS (
  INSERT INTO users_bot_telegram (username, telegram_id)
  VALUES ('{{ $json.username }}', {{ $json.chat_id }})
  ON CONFLICT (telegram_id) DO UPDATE SET username = EXCLUDED.username
  RETURNING id
),
c AS (
  INSERT INTO telegram_conversations (user_id, chat_id, status)
  SELECT id, {{ $json.chat_id }}, 'active' FROM u
  ON CONFLICT (chat_id) WHERE status = 'active' DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id, user_id, current_action, current_step, payload
)
SELECT * FROM c
UNION ALL
SELECT id, user_id, current_action, current_step, payload
FROM telegram_conversations
WHERE chat_id = {{ $json.chat_id }} AND status = 'active'
LIMIT 1;
SELECT id, name FROM categories_bot_telegram WHERE user_id = {{ $('Resolve Conversation').first().json.user_id }} ORDER BY name;

parameters.query:
UPDATE telegram_conversations
SET payload = payload || jsonb_build_object('amount', {{ $json.amount }}::numeric),
    current_step = 'awaiting_category'
WHERE id = {{ $('Resolve Conversation').item.json.id }};

WITH periodo AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - ({{ $json.months }} || ' months')::interval AS inicio,
         date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - ({{ $json.months }} || ' months')::interval + interval '1 month' AS fim
),
anterior AS (
  SELECT inicio - interval '1 month' AS inicio, inicio AS fim FROM periodo
)
SELECT
  {{ $json.months }} AS months,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM expenses_bot_telegram, periodo
     WHERE user_id = {{ $('Resolve Conversation').item.json.user_id }} AND expense_date >= periodo.inicio AND expense_date < periodo.fim) AS total_periodo,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM expenses_bot_telegram, anterior
     WHERE user_id = {{ $('Resolve Conversation').item.json.user_id }} AND expense_date >= anterior.inicio AND expense_date < anterior.fim) AS total_anterior;
SELECT id, name FROM categories_bot_telegram WHERE id = {{ $('Normalize Input').first().json.text }} AND user_id = {{ $json.user_id }};

nodes.name: Valid if the Category Belongs User

parameters.query:
SELECT c.name AS categoria, SUM(e.amount) AS total, COUNT(*) AS qtd
FROM expenses_bot_telegram e
JOIN categories_bot_telegram c ON c.id = e.category_id
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - ({{ $json.months }} || ' months')::interval AS inicio,
         date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - ({{ $json.months }} || ' months')::interval + interval '1 month' AS fim
) periodo
WHERE e.user_id = {{ $('Resolve Conversation').item.json.user_id }}
  AND e.expense_date >= periodo.inicio AND e.expense_date < periodo.fim
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total DESC;
